headline: Revenue up, while margins lag; H2 recovery to follow

highlights: Business Update: Jubilant Pharmova’s Q2FY27 revenue rose 20.5% YoY to Rs23.7bn, with growth primarily coming from CDMO Sterile Injectables (up 32.8% YoY to Rs5.2bn), Generics (up 64.1% YoY to Rs2.7bn), and supported by Radiopharmaceuticals (up 17.5% YoY to Rs3.4bn), and Allergy (up 18.6% YoY to Rs2.3bn).

Sterile Injectables grew on tech transfer revenue from the new Line 3 at Spokane, now working with 13+ products across 5+ customers while generics grew on new launches and share gains in existing products.

EBITDA fell 29.6% YoY to Rs2.4bn, and margin contracted by 721bps YoY to 10.1%; the main drags being the unavailability of high margin SPECT products from the Montreal facility, higher remediation and operating costs, and negligible third-party revenue at Montreal.
Montreal lost over Rs800mn in the quarter with reported PAT down 74.1% YoY to Rs312mn.
valuation: We maintain BUY with a revised target price of Rs1,266 (earlier: Rs1,261), rolling forward our valuation to Sep-28E at 25x P/E.

Valuation: We maintain BUY with a revised target price of Rs1,266 (earlier: Rs1,261), rolling forward our valuation to Sep-28E at 25x P/E, reflecting the improving earnings trajectory from SPECT normalisation, continued CDMO ramp-up, and the upcoming contribution from Line 4.
watch: Outlook: Revenue growth remains healthy during the quarter, but earnings are being held back by the SPECT supply gap and Montreal remediation costs.
Key monitorables would be Montreal’s regulatory progress, SPECT supply, and Line 4 commencement, with a slip in SPECT supply to push the margin recovery into FY28.
